description: ISO New England system load (total electricity demand) in MW at five-minute resolution for the six-state New England footprint. Use for "New England electricity demand right now", "ISO-NE peak load today", demand-response and capacity questions. Requires an API key.

_apiKey.description: ISO Express credential as "username:password" or its base64. Free account at https://www.iso-ne.com/participate/applications-status-changes/.

date.description: Day to fetch as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the current interval.

name: isone_load
title: Isone Load
